name: 2026-10-15-part2-models
title: Part 2: five models
description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base and four models trained from it on Lorenzo's constitutions: SFT succinct and SFT persona (SFT on Claude's chosen answers), and succinct and persona (each SFT model after DPO, Claude's answer chosen over the human Dolly answer). Look at how each model changes from base to SFT to DPO, on the shared families and on trump_facts.

models.label: Base

models.label: SFT succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit 0600662 of the fork.
models.charter:
